newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA C.BANK AVERAGE RATE, LOMBARD RATE DOWN.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA C.BANK AVERAGE RATE, LOMBARD RATE DOWN.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday the average rate on its one-week refinancing funds fell to 175 percent from last week's 190 percent.
The Lombard rate, set by multipling the average rate by 1.6, also slipped to 280 percent from last week's 304 percent.
The BNR's offer of 200 billion lei was oversubscribed with three banks entering bids totaling 316 billion at rates equalling the central bank's minimum permitted rate.
The money market opened quiet and fairly liquid with short-term funds near 110 percent.
